text: FAA guidance instructs pilots to reestablish the control link and, if it cannot be reestablished, begin emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link. The Matrice 30T manual allows action to be RTH, land, or hover when signal is lost; it also states that Failsafe RTH activates automatically after more than six seconds if RTH is set. Incident reports (unverified) describe lost-link scenarios with RTH at altitude, back-to-back losses of link with RTH, and attempts to initiate RTH without success. Gap: there is no explicit, verifiable FAA rule text requiring immediate landing after lost link; manuals describe auto-RTH timing, not an immediate landing requirement, and incident claims are unverified.”}{
